prompts.title: Futuristic Exploded View
prompts.prompt: Create a futuristic exploded view of the object. Separate all components and let them hover with glowing edges and holographic accents. Use a sci-fi environment, neon blue and orange lighting, a dark tech background, and a high-detail 3D render style.

prompts.title: Industrial Exploded View
prompts.prompt: Create an industrial exploded view of the object. Display all internal and external parts separated with precision, including screws, gears, and connectors. Use a workshop-style environment, warm industrial lighting, and a detailed realistic 3D render.

prompts.title: Cinematic Exploded View
prompts.prompt: Create a cinematic exploded view of the object in the attached image. Separate each component and let them float elegantly in space with dynamic angles. Use dramatic lighting, a dark background with subtle rim light, and a highly polished 3D render style with reflections and depth.

prompts.title: Product Design Exploded View
prompts.prompt: Create a product design exploded view of the object. Show every part disassembled and suspended in mid-air, with clean lines and a minimal aesthetic. Use bright even lighting, a white studio background, and a sleek modern 3D render style.
